# XMR Swap

> XMR Swap is a non-custodial interface for swapping Monero (XMR) to USDT, BTC, ETH or LTC and buying XMR with those coins through instant-exchange services. It shows fixed-rate and floating-rate quotes, minimum amounts and swap status. Users receive to their own wallets and are responsible for following local laws.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- XMR is the ticker of Monero, a privacy-focused proof-of-work coin.
- Supported pairs include XMR to USDT, BTC, ETH and LTC, and the reverse direction.
- An order needs a receive address, a refund address and a one-time deposit address from the exchange service.
- Quotes can be fixed-rate or floating-rate, and each route has a minimum amount.
- Status steps are waiting for deposit, confirming, exchanging and sending; the interface never holds private keys.

## Pages

- XMR Swap & learn: https://xmr-swap.github.io/
- Legal: https://xmr-swap.github.io/legal.html
